indiesoftby/defold-yagames/yagames

YaGames is the Yandex.Games SDK implementation for the Defold game engine.

  • GitHub: indiesoftby/defold-yagames — pinned to 0.19.0
    1. Pick a release from indiesoftby/defold-yagames releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

init(callback: ApiCallback)U

Initializes YaGames extension and waits for Yandex.Games SDK initialization

Parameters

  • callback: ApiCallback — Callback arguments are (self, err). If err is not nil, something is wrong.

adv_show_fullscreen_adv(callbacks: AdvCallbacks)U

Calls the fullscreen ad. Fullscreen ad block - advertising blocks that completely cover the game background and are shown when a player waits for something (for example, when switching to the next level of the game).

Parameters

  • callbacks: AdvCallbacks — open - Called when an ad is opened successfully. close - Called when an ad is closed, an error occurred, or on ad failed to open due to too frequent calls. Used with the was_shown argument (type boolean), the value of which indicates whether an ad was shown. offline - Called when the network connection is lost (when offline mode is enabled). error - Called when an error occurrs. The error object is passed to the callback function.

adv_show_rewarded_video(callbacks: RewardedCallbacks)U

Calls the rewarded video ad. Rewarded videos are video ad blocks used to monetize games and earn a reward or in-game currency.

Parameters

  • callbacks: RewardedCallbacks — open - Called when a video ad is displayed on the screen. rewarded - Called when a video ad impression is counted. Use this function to specify a reward for viewing the video ad. close - Called when a user closes a video ad or an error happens. error - Called when an error occurrs. The error object is passed to the callback function.

player_set_data(data: Record<string, unknown>, flush: boolean, callback: ApiCallback)U

Saves user data. The maximum data size should not exceed 200 KB.

Parameters

  • data: Record<string, unknown> — A table containing key-value pairs. Example: { "a" = "value", "b" = 2 }.
  • flush: boolean — Specifies the order data is sent. If the value is “true”, the data is immediately sent to the server. If it's “false” (default), the request to send data is queued.
  • callback: ApiCallback — Callback arguments are (self, err)

player_get_data(keys: Array<string> | undefined, callback: ApiCallback)U

Asynchronously returns the in-game user data stored in the Yandex database.

Parameters

  • keys: Array<string> | undefined
  • callback: ApiCallback — Callback arguments are (self, err, result), where result are pairs as key-values, i.e. { "a" = "value", "b" = 2 }.

Save the user's numeric data. The maximum data size must not exceed 10 KB.

Parameters

  • callback: ApiCallback — Callback arguments are (self, err, result), where result are changed pairs as key-values, i.e. { "a" = 1, "b" = 2 }.

multiplayer_sessions_init(options: MultiplayerSessionsInitOptions, callback: MultiplayerSessionsInitCallback)U

Initialize the multiplayer sessions. If isEventBased is true, you must subscribe to the events multiplayer-sessions-transaction and multiplayer-sessions-finish through yagames.event_on(event_name, listener), and the SDK itself will load the session and events at the specified timestamps. Note: To load sessions, you must set at least one of the 3 meta-parameters, and the count parameter must be greater than zero. Otherwise, the multiplayer will be initialized only for writing data.

Parameters

  • options: MultiplayerSessionsInitOptions
  • callback: MultiplayerSessionsInitCallback — Callback arguments are (self, err, result), where result is table (array)

Variables

ysdk_ready: boolean

true once init has succeeded; the calls that need the SDK assert it before they run.

payments_ready: boolean

true after the latest payments_init succeeded; the purchase calls assert it before they run.

player_ready: boolean

true after the latest player_init succeeded; the player calls assert it before they run.

banner_ready: boolean

Starts as false, and no call in this version of the library sets it, so it stays false.

Types

type Context = unknown

type ApiCallback = (self: Context, err?: string, data?: unknown) => void

type StickyBannerCallback = (ctx: Context, err?: string, result?: StickyBannerStatus) => void

type StickyBannerHideCallback = (ctx: Context, err?: string, result?: { stickyAdvIsShowing: boolean; }) => void

type PlayerGetIdsCallback = (ctx: Context, err?: string, data?: Array<{ appID: string; userID: string; }>) => void

type PlayerPersonalInfo = Record<string, unknown>

type PaymentsPurchaseCallback = (ctx: Context, err?: string, data?: { productId: string; purchaseToken: string; developerPayload: string; signature: string; }) => void
